notices.title: Virginia Creeper closure
notices.body: The Damascus–Whitetop section remains closed for reconstruction. All incoming Virginia Creeper records are held.

notices.title: Warm Springs access
notices.body: FSR 125 D (Skyline Drive) is closed for repairs through approximately December 2026. This is a road closure, not evidence that Bear Loop is closed. Check the approach for Sandy Gap with the district.

notices.title: Forest alerts
notices.body: Current alerts also include road work, Grindstone parking and Glen Alton construction closures. Managed hiking dates do not override forest orders.
